summary: Serve source-aligned EXL3 routed experts without padded weight payloads
compatibility: Requires the B12X common trellis preparation API and an EXL3 manifest checkpoint; Kimi serving also requires mixed-precision KDA and MLA projection support.
details: Preserves serialized dense weight formats and BF16 expert activations with FP16 trellis rotations.
Derives routed-expert runtime widths from source-aligned TP extents while preserving checkpoint dimensions.
